node.title: XR deficient window: exact phi-fiber and split-pencil router
node.statement: For every selected r-point active-defect block, the number of triples on three distinct phi=[P:Q] fibers is the third elementary symmetric function of the fiber multiplicities and is minimized by the maximally packed ell-capped profile. Conditional on at least three fibers, the exact minimum is r-2 for r<=ell+2, ell(r-ell-1) for ell+2<r<=2ell, and the packed-profile value for r>2ell. A block on at most two fibers has its square-free locator dividing one or two members of the primitive pencil bP-aQ. Thus the triple-incidence method routes every uncounted target into an exact split-pencil endpoint with at least two disjoint selected block locators; it does not by itself pay that endpoint or the high-fiber upper tails.
